I saved 21 October as Pree's cutoff date for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork, effective from 14 October 2026. The note includes where it came from (this DM and its timestamp) and is marked private, so it won't be shared with other members. I confirmed this to Pree in the DM.

There are two limits on how well this note is stored:
- **Exact-match duplicate check only.** No embedding provider is configured, so the memory store only catches duplicates worded exactly the same way. If someone saves this cutoff again in different words, it will be stored as a second note.
- **Database only, no file copy.** The note went into the memory database, but nothing was written to a file because no repository is configured for that.

The memory system also reported that the server is blocking 121 operations this connection would otherwise be allowed to use. Only the owner of the memory system can change that, by running `gbrain doctor --only grant_new_ops_available --json` on its host. It didn't affect this task.
